name: Ankit Kashyap
text: I visited Dr. Devansh Sharma at DS Polyclinic after suffering from severe back spasms and shooting pain down my leg. He took 30 minutes just to test my posture and joint movement before touching anything. The manual therapy and structured home exercises gave me relief in just 3 sessions.

name: Smt. Sharda Devi & Family
text: Booked home visits for my elderly mother in Gaur City 2 after her knee surgery. Dr. Devansh is extremely respectful, patient, and punctual. He guided her through every step of balance and gait training without rushing. True doctor-led care.

name: Vipin Tyagi
text: Working 12 hours on screens caused chronic neck stiffness and migraines. Dr. Devansh applied dry cupping and thoracic mobilisation. The knots released almost instantly. The clinic in SS Plaza is quiet, private, and exceptionally clean.

name: Priyanka Saxena
text: Could not lift my arm above shoulder height for nearly 5 months. Dr. Devansh never passed me to an assistant; every single minute was consultant-delivered. I have restored 95% of my natural range.
